raw_text: Absolutely heartbreaking. 4 CRPF jawans martyred in Latehar. These men put their lives on the line every day in the most dangerous terrain in India. The Burha Pahar area has been a Maoist stronghold for decades and these convoys are sitting ducks on those narrow forest roads. When will we learn? The LWE problem is NOT solved — it has just moved. Rest in peace brave soldiers.
clean_text: Reddit user mourns 4 CRPF jawans killed in Latehar. Notes Burha Pahar as long-term Maoist stronghold with convoys vulnerable on narrow forest roads. Argues LWE problem not solved but displaced.
